definition: With one style chosen, hold shift and click a second, in the tree or on the map, to open the two side by side at an address of their own: how to tell them apart, and where their kits, packs and plan types differ.
basis: The gesture is the workbench's own, ruled for Phase 14. What it opens compares each style's record: schema/style-node.schema.json, "Explicit disambiguation against commonly-confused neighbours.", and mcp_server/core.py, where there is none, "none recorded — fall back on the tells below".
